REVIEWED SEMANTIC MAPPING, NOT SYNTAX REPLACEMENT

Before coding: establish grain, expected output, filters/context, data types,
null/blank semantics, collation/case, timezone and date calendar. Preserve the
source-object ID and approved target identifier separately. Do not use captions
as a unique key; escape TMDL, DAX, M and JSON names in their respective grammars.

Source                              Candidate target / required review
------                              ----------------------------------
Physical table, typed fields        M connector/navigation/type steps + columns.
                                    Map integer -> int64, real -> double or an
                                    approved decimal type, string -> string,
                                    boolean -> boolean, date/datetime deliberately.
                                    Currency precision and spatial need review.
Logical relations/blending          Model tables/relationships or reviewed M join.
                                    Validate grain, multiplicity, join behavior,
                                    filter directions and totals first.
Row-level calculation              M column or DAX calculated column depending
                                    on refresh/evaluation intent, not a measure
                                    merely because it contains arithmetic.
Aggregate calculation              Explicit DAX measure; validate aggregation.
                                    Simple SUM([Sales]) may become SUM('Sales'[Sales])
                                    ONLY after field/grain/type/filter review.
{FIXED/INCLUDE/EXCLUDE ...}          Per-calculation design; may use SUMMARIZE,
                                    CALCULATE, REMOVEFILTERS or different modeling,
                                    but none is a universal LOD translation.
                                    Test context vs dimension filters and totals.
WINDOW_*, RUNNING_*, LOOKUP, RANK    Requires partition/addressing/order/frame and
                                    sort/null semantics. Model or DAX redesign;
                                    visual calculations only when supported and
                                    deliberately approved for the target build.
ATTR, COUNTD, null behavior         ATTR is not blindly SELECTEDVALUE; Tableau
                                    nulls and DAX BLANK coercion may diverge.
                                    Test mixed values, empty sets, blank counts.
Parameters                         What-if table/measure, field parameter or M
                                    parameter after classifying user-vs-refresh
                                    behavior. Not interchangeable.
Sets/groups/bins/hierarchies        Reviewed columns/tables/hierarchies/slicers.
                                    Dynamic membership and selection need tests.
Filters/context/user functions     Report/page/visual filters or roles with
                                    explicit semantics; never infer RLS solely
                                    from a Tableau worksheet filter.
Custom SQL                         Security/code review plus approved native
                                    query or view; read-only credentials,
                                    folding/refresh behavior, no auto-execution.
Published datasource              Obtain authorized metadata and source mapping;
                                    not a reusable Power BI connector by itself.
Hyper/TDE extract                  Unsupported by these scripts. Approved
                                    upstream connector/export required.
Actions                            Explicit cross-filter/highlight, drillthrough,
                                    navigation or bookmarks; URL actions and
                                    external side effects require separate review.
Dashboard layout                   Pages/containers with reviewed scaling.
                                    Tableau zones can use normalized coordinates
                                    and nested layouts. No direct pixel copying.
Maps/spatial, stories, extensions   Explicit unsupported/review-needed unless a
                                    tested replacement is approved. External
                                    tiles/resources and custom visuals need
                                    security, licensing and accessibility review.

M SOURCE EXAMPLE (illustrative, not runnable project configuration)
  let
      Source = Sql.Database(Server, Database),
      Sales = Source{[Schema="dbo", Item="Sales"]}[Data],
      Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Sales,
                  {{"OrderDate", type date}, {"Amount", type number}})
  in
      Typed
Server/Database must be approved non-secret configuration. Authenticate in
Desktop/service credentials. Do not embed workbook credentials or URI tokens.
Do not substitute the synthetic starter table for unavailable production data.

MINIMUM PARITY CASES
  row counts, distinct key counts, duplicate keys, orphan keys, nulls/BLANKs;
  row-level and grouped measures, grand totals vs sum of subtotals;
  multiple filters, context filter precedence, slicer reset, RLS identities;
  date boundaries, week/year starts, timezones, leap days, decimal rounding;
  LOD at differing view grains; table-calc sort/partition/frame changes;
  parameter changes, selection actions, navigation, tooltip/drillthrough;
  visual ordering, conditional formatting, layout and accessibility.

Acceptance evidence must identify source version, target build, approved dataset
snapshot (without copying data into public logs), tolerances, actual results and
reviewer approval. A plausible chart alone is not a semantic test.
